title: C2 planner decomposition verdict
description: Structured output emitted by the C2 /planner skill body indicating whether the planned work is atomic (a single deliverable) or should be split into independent child work units. Consumed by the C7 work-orchestrator plan stage.

schema_version.description: Schema version — always '1.0' for this release.

decomposition.description: Verdict: 'atomic' when the work is a single independent deliverable; 'split' when the planner judges the work to be more than one independent unit and emits child descriptors.

children.description: Required when decomposition is 'split'. Each entry describes one independent child work unit. Must be absent or empty when decomposition is 'atomic'.

title.description: Short human-readable title for the child work unit.

spec_seed.description: A brief spec-seed (goal + scope) that C1 /spec-write can expand into a full spec for this child.

rationale.description: One or two sentences explaining why this is an independent unit and how it relates to the parent goal.
